subhead: Take a free practice quiz or point your phone at any Cengage MindTap question for an instant, explained answer — Sociology, History, and gen-ed reading checks, without the guesswork.
metaTitle: Cengage MindTap Answers & Practice Questions | Cambo
metaDescription: Free practice questions and instant, explained answers for Cengage MindTap quizzes and homework. Sociology, History, and general gen-ed courses.
whyItWorks: MindTap reading-comprehension questions usually hinge on a specific passage, date, or term from that unit's assigned reading, so the right answer depends on recognizing exactly what the textbook said rather than general outside knowledge. Cambo reads the exact question and answer choices on your screen and explains which one matches the source material and why the others don't.

sampleQuestions.q: In sociology, the term 'socialization' refers to:
options: The process by which individuals learn the norms, values, and behaviors of their society
A government policy that redistributes wealth
The study of how societies form political parties
A method of collecting survey data
sampleQuestions.a: Socialization is the lifelong process through which individuals internalize the norms, values, and behaviors expected within their culture and society.

sampleQuestions.q: Which event is generally considered the immediate trigger for the start of World War I?
options: The signing of the Treaty of Versailles
The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand
The invasion of Poland
The sinking of the Lusitania
sampleQuestions.a: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Hungary in June 1914 set off the chain of alliances and declarations that led directly to the outbreak of WWI.

sampleQuestions.q: According to functionalist theory in sociology, social institutions like schools and families primarily exist to:
options: Create class conflict
Maintain social stability and meet society's needs
Enforce a single dominant ideology through force
Replace the need for government entirely
sampleQuestions.a: Functionalism views institutions as interdependent parts that work together to maintain social order and stability, each meeting a specific societal need.

sampleQuestions.q: The Emancipation Proclamation, issued in 1863, primarily did which of the following?
options: Ended slavery in all U.S. states immediately
Declared enslaved people in Confederate-held territory to be free
Granted full voting rights to formerly enslaved people
Ended the Civil War
sampleQuestions.a: It declared enslaved people in Confederate-held territory free — it did not immediately free enslaved people in border states that remained in the Union, and full abolition came later with the 13th Amendment.

sampleQuestions.q: The Renaissance, which began in Italy in the 14th century, is best described as a period of:
options: Decline in art and learning
Renewed interest in classical Greek and Roman art, learning, and humanism
Total rejection of religious themes in art
The founding of the first European colonies in the Americas
sampleQuestions.a: The Renaissance marked a revival of interest in classical antiquity and humanist thought, driving major advances in art, science, and literature.

faqs.a: MindTap is Cengage Learning's online course platform that packages a digital textbook, reading activities, and auto-graded quizzes into one interactive courseware experience.

faqs.q: What subjects is MindTap most commonly used for?
faqs.a: It's especially common in Sociology, History, and other general-education courses, where it's often used for reading-comprehension-style quizzes tied to assigned chapters.

faqs.q: Are MindTap questions usually multiple choice?
faqs.a: Mostly, yes — MindTap gen-ed courses lean heavily on multiple-choice reading checks, though some assignments include short-answer or matching questions as well.

faqs.q: Does MindTap track how much time I spend reading, not just quiz scores?
faqs.a: Yes — MindTap's analytics can track engagement with the digital textbook itself (time on page, highlights, etc.) in addition to quiz performance, which is part of why instructors often assign it alongside graded quizzes.

faqs.q: Is Cambo affiliated with Cengage Learning?
faqs.a: No. Cambo is an independent study tool and isn't produced, endorsed, or affiliated with Cengage Learning.

faqs.q: How is MindTap different from Aplia, which is also a Cengage product?
faqs.a: Both are made by Cengage, but MindTap is built around general digital-textbook courseware across many subjects, while Aplia is a separate, more specialized platform focused heavily on Economics problem sets — see our dedicated Aplia page for that use case.
